A guided first connection

Start with the tools you have.

Choose an implementation and client to get the right setup steps. This guide stays in your browser: it never scans your computer or sends project files anywhere.

Fastest on a Mac: let the installer do it

It detects your apps and MCP clients, shows the plan, then installs, registers and checks every server.

brew tap zachshallbetter/tap
brew trust zachshallbetter/tap
brew install zachshallbetter/tap/creative-mcp
creative-mcp setup
